status: prepared and unpublished; guild completion disk handoff and bounded replay implemented
scope: Qualifying server-produced clears write one immutable checksummed private receipt per instance before requesting replay. Each bounded receipt preserves captured guilds/counts, original time/season, difficulty, level and duration; no wallets, auth payloads or later membership lookup.

New journal files are0600 and new directories0700 on the existing durable save volume; existing directory permissions are not silently changed. Hashed filenames, atomic temporary-write/fsync/rename/directory-sync, identical retries and conflict rejection preserve original results. Decoding is limited to32KiB per regular file and an explicit1–100 receipt batch; directory reads use32-entry chunks.

Completion and periodic recovery share one worker and one pending bit. A pass reads at most9 receipts and commits at most8, retaining an honest pending marker; rejected admission or failed/partial writes/acknowledgements leave receipts for later recovery.

Startup makes one bounded leaderboard pass and leaves stale leaderboard records for periodic/operator recovery without granting stale characters, wallets or permissions. Corruption is not deleted or hidden to force successful replay.
Removed post-clear guild-state broadcasts, which carried no leaderboard data and repeatedly queried members. The actual leaderboard still refreshes through its existing requested server snapshot.

Filesystem recording failure is returned/logged and privately reported to actual run participants, without claiming secured tracking. Gameplay rewards remain on their separate existing persistence path.

limits: The initial completion is not crash durable before its filesystem write succeeds. A failed local write is reported but not called secured or silently added to an unbounded RAM queue. Total journal disk growth and operator repair/retention remain broader persistence work.
Membership remains the recorded server-owned world mirror at reward/repair credit, not a cross-store exact-kill transaction. Earlier capture receipt retains that limitation.

Direct journal/database recovery, not a latest connected application binary, full four-player dungeon clear, production outage or capacity certificate. Latest integrated/release checks and ordered publication remain required.

The reader compatibility must be deployed in1.71 before1.72 writes this child directory. Earlier1.70 does not support that new directory; it is not claimed as a direct rollback target. Preserve the outbox with the durable volume/backup, not an ephemeral image directory.
